accepted_outputs: Corrected 40300 unique-key sample, 69 support cells and weighting receipt
Exact-locator materialization of 200 development records; fixed 80-key subset
Versioned input, independent labels, first-pass failures and aggregate comparison receipts

configuration_decisions.gpt-5.6-terra/medium: Reject this prompt/workflow configuration for the core semantic task: pervasive missing explicit duration, wrong scope/strength, and semantic changes during purported quote-only repair. This is not a claim about the model in general.
configuration_decisions.gpt-5.6-sol/medium: Retain only as a diagnostic candidate. It preserves more explicit durations and distinctions in the inspected cases, but shared omissions and scope/strength errors prevent unattended-production acceptance. No general accuracy estimate.

material_rulings: A duration tied to an occupation, task, domain or tool stays attached to that object. Do not infer unrestricted total career tenure from it.
Required and preferred remain distinct, including section boundaries; ambiguous scope stays unresolved.

Education-or-work-experience clauses retain actual conditional work-year branches. A degree is not years of employment, and conditional years are not a universal minimum. Never add alternative branches.
Proficiency, knowledge and unclear exposure are distinct from stated prior experience. Split clauses with genuinely different modes instead of collapsing them.
Deployment/maintenance alone does not establish model development or training; preserve supported role evidence and leave unsupported roles unresolved.
Repairing quotes must not alter semantic labels invisibly. Report initial annotation and repaired serialization separately.

cost_control.stop_reason: Material core failures already identified in the first paired 20. Spending on another 60 paired records would not remove those failures.

research_use.existing_engineering_and_coverage_result: Retain with existing scope and source-time caveats. Sampling correction does not invalidate raw data or frozen old T1-T6.
research_use.experience_role_year_semantics: Candidate measurements and development diagnostics only; not accepted economic estimates.
research_use.historical_current_description: Current body cannot be interpreted as the original historical wording merely from a unique URL hash or observed dates.
research_use.individual_histories: Deferred: Revelio Individual is not acquired.

next_bounded_action: Use these retained artifacts and rulings for the next authorized measurement execution; do not re-clean the full corpus, purchase API/data access, or rerun 40300 records automatically. Existing aggregate work can be reported at its candidate-measurement status.
limitations: Nonrandom early stopping and four targeted adjudications do not estimate population accuracy.
No human validation occurred; all readings and adjudication were by AI.
No full-record all-dimension agreement cases were available in the paired 20; shared omissions were checked directly against sources.
Evaluation remains unrevealed and not finally text-deduplicated against unavailable historical review texts.
privacy: No source text, record IDs, credentials or row-level labels in this public decision.
